purpose: Adopt and exercise a high-reputation external Windows UI Automation library against the real desktop while preserving a read-only and privacy boundary.

activities.label: download official pywinauto repository and pin stable tag 0.6.9
enumerate real Windows UIA windows and optional control metadata without emitting titles or injecting input
attack raw title emission input injection screen capture network write and backend policy
record external tool adoption decision and remaining surface semantics unknowns

queries.expression: can a pinned external UIA library obtain real desktop structure without screenshot camera or input injection
does the adapter keep raw window titles and user input out of the emitted observation
does real UIA structure add information beyond FARMAKSIA synthetic fixtures
is the adoption reproducible from pinned source tag dependencies and suite registration

assumptions: The official pywinauto repository and tag 0.6.9 are the selected high-reputation external source.
Microsoft UI Automation is the target Windows accessibility/control surface, not a guarantee of complete app semantics.
The local desktop window list is observation data and can change between runs.
Read-only enumeration is allowed without user-specific application authorization, while actions require a separate capability.
External dependencies must remain pinned and auditable before entering the product runtime.
kill_tests: Raw window titles emitted by the adapter are blocked.
Injected click or keyboard action is blocked.
An invalid window count is blocked.
unknowns: Whether the target application exposes enough UIA roles states bounds and patterns for a useful representation.
Whether UIA observation is faster and more stable than screenshot or coordinate approaches on the target application.
Whether a real action can be independently verified without relying on the adapter's own observation.
Whether pywinauto 0.6.9 remains compatible with future Python and Windows versions.
Whether a web target should use Playwright instead of the Windows adapter.
